tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Assets this endpoint can simulate, with the date each series starts and ends. Call before composing a plan so start dates fall inside coverage.

tools.name: data_status
tools.description: The vintage of the loaded price data and how often it refreshes.

tools.name: run_dca
tools.description: Simulate one dollar-cost-averaging plan against real historical closes. Returns totals, end-of-year checkpoints and a share_url that opens the same run in the app.

type.description: "dca" repeats on the schedule; "lump-sum" buys once at the start. Default "dca".

amount.description: USD per contribution, or the single amount for lump-sum.

frequency.description: Contribution cadence. Default "monthly". Quarterly is the coarsest offered: wider gaps behave like a few lump sums (see the knowledge base, "The gap between buys").

end_date.description: Window end. Defaults to the last loaded close, never a relative "today".

wait_periods.description: Save this many scheduled contributions as cash before the first purchase.

last_buy_date.description: Stop buying here and hold to end_date.

as_of.description: Pin the answer to this data vintage so the share link keeps returning the same number.

settings.description: Chart overlays carried into share_url, and the figures they add to each summary. Flags marked "Pro only" need a signed-in Pro account or a Pro API key; without one, the call returns an error naming the setting.

fng.description: Draw the Fear & Greed overlay on the shared chart.

log.description: Log scale on the shared chart.

lump.description: Pro only. Lump-sum benchmark: the same total bought at once on day one. Adds lump_sum_equivalent_final_value to the summary and the overlay to share_url.

cpi.description: Pro only. Inflation arm: what the contributed cash is worth after CPI-U. Adds cash_after_cpi to the summary and the overlay to share_url.

mayer.description: Pro only. Mayer Multiple overlay on the shared chart.

risk.description: Pro only. Adds annualized sharpe and sortino to the summary.

smart.description: Pro only. Buy rule: a signal read on each purchase date, two thresholds, and a multiplier for each of the three bands they make. `true` is the Mayer default (0.8/2.4 — buy as usual, skip above 2.4); an object sets its own. Adds `rule` and `rule_finding` (cost per unit against flat purchases from fixed starts) to the summary and the rule to share_url.

signal.description: Which reading decides each purchase. mayer (default): price vs its 200-day average, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and XRP. fng: the alternative.me Fear & Greed index (0-100), the same four assets. dd: percent below the running high close, any market asset (not bonds or index levels).

high.description: Upper threshold, from the same list and above low. Defaults mayer 2.4, fng 75, dd 50.

below.description: Multiplier on the scheduled amount when the reading is under low: one of 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6. 0 skips the purchase (that money is not invested).

between.description: Multiplier when the reading is between the thresholds, same list. Default 1.

above.description: Multiplier when the reading is over high, same list. Defaults: mayer 0 and fng 0 (skip the euphoric top), dd 2 (double in a deep drawdown).

bank.description: Hold and deploy: the cash a band below 1× withholds is kept and spent on the next purchase the rule does not scale down, and counts as invested from the day it was scheduled. With no band above 1× the rule then invests the same total as flat purchases, so final value is comparable too. Any pile still standing at the end is reported as cash_held. Default false.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Run up to 5 plans over the same data and rank them by final value (2 without a signed-in Pro account or a Pro API key). Use to compare assets, cadences or start dates side by side. One share_url opens them all together.

type.description: "dca" repeats on the schedule; "lump-sum" buys once at the start. Default "dca".

amount.description: USD per contribution, or the single amount for lump-sum.

frequency.description: Contribution cadence. Default "monthly". Quarterly is the coarsest offered: wider gaps behave like a few lump sums (see the knowledge base, "The gap between buys").

end_date.description: Window end. Defaults to the last loaded close, never a relative "today".

wait_periods.description: Save this many scheduled contributions as cash before the first purchase.

last_buy_date.description: Stop buying here and hold to end_date.

plans.description: The plans to compare: up to 2 anonymously or on a Free-account key, up to 5 with a signed-in Pro account or a Pro API key.
